summary: Per explicit human authorization following Phase 146H.2's ROOT CAUSE ESTABLISHED verdict, independently reconfirmed the CONFIRMATION_UNBOUND defect from scratch (a genuine build_publication_record bundle verified through the real pcae governance-record verify CLI, not from 146H.2's own saved evidence) before touching any code. Repaired governance/verification.py's confirmation_binding, provenance_consistency, and integrity_consistency checks: all three compared against the obsolete _confirmable_content_digest_of(record) helper (a digest recomputed over the human_governance_record's own stripped content -- the original Phase 143E design). Removed that helper entirely and retargeted each comparison at the actual CHGR-REQ-201/CHGR-REQ-203 relationship record.py's real Phase 146G construction path uses: confirmed_content_digest <-> preview_rendering_digest (both sourced from the same upstream PublicationReadinessPackage.preview_digest), provenance.preview_content_digest <-> confirmation.confirmed_content_digest, and integrity.payload_digest <-> the record's own already-verified record_digest. The third site was not separately named in this phase's Human Authorization but shares the identical root cause and was required to meet the phase's own mandated outcome (a genuine bundle verifying successfully end to end) -- live-reproduced: with only the first two sites fixed, a genuine bundle traded CONFIRMATION_UNBOUND for a new DIGEST_MISMATCH instead of verifying. Documented as directly associated, not scope creep. Corrected the stale Phase-143E-era confirmed_content_digest schema field description (human_confirmation_evidence.schema.json) to state the actual, frozen CHGR-REQ-201 rule; updated its one dependent manifest file_digest. No field name, type, required status, schema identity, schema version, or validation semantics changed. Migrated 3 pre-existing test fixtures that encoded the obsolete formula; every other fixture (positive and adversarial) independently confirmed unaffected. A genuine build_publication_record bundle now verifies successfully through both the internal verification API and the real CLI, live-reproduced. Fail-closed behavior preserved throughout. Full evidence, root-cause trace, repair description, fixture migration assessment, and adversarial verification matrix in docs/PHASE_146H3_CONFIRMATION_BINDING_VERIFICATION_REPAIR.md. Verdict: REPAIR COMPLETE. Recommends 146H.3V -- Confirmation Binding Verification Repair Independent Verification, covering both the 146H.1 schema-version repair and this phase's confirmation-binding repair together.
tests_added_or_updated: 17 new tests added (tests/test_phase_146h3_confirmation_binding_verification_repair.py): matching upstream preview-digest values pass; each binding field mismatch (confirmed_content_digest, preview_rendering_digest, provenance.preview_content_digest, integrity.payload_digest) fails independently with its correct error code; malformed digest rejected at schema shape; missing binding field rejected; the obsolete record-content-derived formula no longer coincidentally satisfies binding; confirmation_binding no longer depends on Human Governance Record content; missing sibling explicitly reported skipped, never silently passed; genuine production bundle verifies through both the internal API and the real CLI (in-process, via pcae.cli.main); tampered confirmation sibling rejected through the real CLI; unsupported schema version and tamper detection unaffected. 3 pre-existing fixtures migrated (tests/fixtures/chgr/valid_confirmation_evidence.json, valid_integrity.json, adversarial_assurance_overclaim_selfconsistent_confirmation.json).

No CHGR-REQ-201 rewrite was performed -- the repair verifies the exact relationship it already specifies via the fields it already names. No redesign of confirmation semantics was performed: every check retains its name, error code, and skip-vs-fail semantics; only three digest comparisons' right-hand sides were retargeted at the actually-correct authoritative field. No redesign of the verification subsystem was performed. No redesign of the Publication Coordinator was performed (src/pcae/governance/publication/coordinator.py untouched). No modification was made to artifact ownership. No modification was made to lifecycle sequencing. No execution capability was added (Registry status: empty, Plugin count: 0, unchanged before and after). No digest validation was weakened -- every existing fail-closed rejection case still rejects (see adversarial_verification_matrix). No arbitrary equivalent values are broadly accepted -- the repaired checks remain exact-equality comparisons against specific, named, authoritative fields. No unrelated finding was repaired -- the two pre-existing, unrelated limitations independently observed (the artifact_reference model's sibling-substitution tolerance, pre-existing and documented in record.py's own module docstring; and an unrelated src/pcae/cltr/authority_inspection.py file-scope drift discovered during regression) were disclosed, not touched. No independent verification of this phase's own work was performed or begun -- that is 146H.3V's separate, distinctly authorized scope. No schema-version bump was performed on human_confirmation_evidence.schema.json (the field-description correction is non-structural; no repository rule ties schema_version to description text alone).
